function.name: kinematics_final_velocity
function.description: Find the final velocity of an object moving under constant acceleration.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s.

time.description: The time in seconds the object has been moving.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. Default value is -9.81 (Earth's gravity) This is a float type value.
